test_GIL_deadlock_single_thread: test that Python to C++ to Python callbacks do not deadlock in a single thread
test_GIL_deadlock_parallel_threads: test that Python to C++ to Python callbacks do not deadlock across 8 parallel threads
test_GIL_deadlock_sequential_threads: test that Python to C++ to Python callbacks do not deadlock across 8 sequential threads
test_GIL_deadlock_multiprocess: test that Python to C++ to Python callbacks do not deadlock when run in a separate process
run_target_in_subprocess: run a target function in a subprocess with a 10 second timeout and return its exit code
